rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server integrates Drone CI/CD into AI workflows, providing tools for repository management, build operations (list, restart, cancel, promote, approve), log retrieval by stage and step, cron job scheduling, secret management at repository and organization levels, user administration, and pipeline template management. Supports both stdio and SSE HTTP transport modes with optional Bearer token authentication.
